datasets.name: OAIZIB-CM
datasets.intended_use: Knee bone and cartilage segmentation, OA morphometrics
datasets.citation: Yao et al., CartiMorph: A framework for automated knee articular cartilage morphometrics, Medical Image Analysis, 2024

datasets.name: SKM-TEA
datasets.reason: ~900GB compressed, exceeds available storage (149GB). Investigate subset options.
datasets.alternative: Consider using meniscus annotations from smaller public datasets or transfer learning from pretrained models.
datasets.citation: Desai et al., SKM-TEA: A Dataset for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction with Dense Image Labels for Quantitative Clinical Evaluation, NeurIPS Datasets 2022

datasets.name: ShapeMed-Knee
datasets.reason: ~424GB, exceeds available storage. Investigate pretrained shape model or small subset.
datasets.alternative: Use our own 3D reconstructions from OAIZIB-CM segmentation masks as shape representations.
datasets.citation: Gatti et al., ShapeMed-Knee: A Dataset and Neural Shape Model Benchmark for Modeling 3D Femurs, 2024

storage_constraints.note: Only OAIZIB-CM fits within storage budget. Alternative approaches needed for SKM-TEA and ShapeMed-Knee.

data_integrity.split_strategy: Pre-defined by dataset authors (404 train / 103 test). No patient overlap.
data_integrity.exclusion_reason: Case 454 identified as corrupted by dataset maintainers (Feb 2025)
